core_obligations: Deformation category setup (proof lines 1443-1450): (RS*) gives (RS), fibres are deformation categories.
Reduction to k (proof lines 1452-1467): base change identifies X_0's stack with the 2-fibre product; the fibre-product lemma plus finite dimensionality for B and Spec(k) reduce to B = Spec(k).

Tangent identification (proof lines 1469-1487): X_epsilon is a flat first order thickening; the thickening lemma identifies T F with lifts, computed as Ext^1_{O_{X_0}}(G_0, G_0) by the deformation theory lemma; Inf = Ext^0 likewise.
Finiteness (proof lines 1488-1502): G_0 is coherent on the Noetherian X_0, so the cited Ext-finiteness lemma applies.
proof_roadmap: Set up deformation categories via (RS*) (proof lines 1443-1450).
Reduce to B = Spec(k) by base change (proof lines 1452-1467).
Identify T F = Ext^1 and Inf = Ext^0 via the thickening (proof lines 1469-1487).
